title: CI traffic
description: Umbrella Flow: traffic of one CI from ClickHouse. Umbrella's incident context link fills var-ci, var-ci_id, var-ip and var-ref (docs/integrations.md §3.5).

list.name: ci
list.label: CI
list.description: Umbrella CI name; used only when ref and ip are empty (matched against SrcCI / DstCI and SrcHost / DstHost)

list.name: ref
list.label: Inventory DB ref
list.description: Inventory DB source_ref, e.g. inventory-db:dcim.device:100 (SrcCI / DstCI)

panels.title: CI traffic in / out
panels.description: Bits per second to and from the CI: by Inventory DB source_ref ($ref), else by address ($ip), else by CI name ($ci). Raw flows, sampling already applied.

targets.rawSql:
WITH
    ((${ref:sqlstring} != '' AND SrcCI = ${ref:sqlstring}) OR (${ip:sqlstring} != '' AND SrcAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring})) OR (${ref:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ip:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ci:sqlstring} != '' AND (SrcCI = ${ci:sqlstring} OR SrcHost = ${ci:sqlstring}))) AS from_ci,
    ((${ref:sqlstring} != '' AND DstCI = ${ref:sqlstring}) OR (${ip:sqlstring} != '' AND DstAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring})) OR (${ref:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ip:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ci:sqlstring} != '' AND (DstCI = ${ci:sqlstring} OR DstHost = ${ci:sqlstring}))) AS to_ci
SELECT
    $__timeInterval(TimeReceived) AS time,
    toFloat64(sumIf(Bytes, to_ci)) * 8 / $__interval_s AS "In (to the CI)",
    toFloat64(sumIf(Bytes, from_ci)) * 8 / $__interval_s AS "Out (from the CI)"
FROM flow.flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (from_ci OR to_ci)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Top talkers
panels.description: Addresses exchanging the most traffic with the CI over the selected range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH
    ((${ref:sqlstring} != '' AND SrcCI = ${ref:sqlstring}) OR (${ip:sqlstring} != '' AND SrcAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring})) OR (${ref:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ip:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ci:sqlstring} != '' AND (SrcCI = ${ci:sqlstring} OR SrcHost = ${ci:sqlstring}))) AS from_ci,
    ((${ref:sqlstring} != '' AND DstCI = ${ref:sqlstring}) OR (${ip:sqlstring} != '' AND DstAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring})) OR (${ref:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ip:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ci:sqlstring} != '' AND (DstCI = ${ci:sqlstring} OR DstHost = ${ci:sqlstring}))) AS to_ci
SELECT
    replaceRegexpOne(toString(if(from_ci, DstAddr, SrcAddr)), '^::ffff:([0-9.]+)$', '\\1') AS "Peer",
    any(if(from_ci, DstHost, SrcHost)) AS "Host",
    any(if(from_ci, DstCI, SrcCI)) AS "Peer CI",
    toFloat64(sumIf(Bytes, to_ci)) * 8 / $__range_s AS "In, bit/s",
    toFloat64(sumIf(Bytes, from_ci)) * 8 / $__range_s AS "Out, bit/s",
    sum(Bytes) AS "Bytes"
FROM flow.flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (from_ci OR to_ci)
GROUP BY "Peer"
ORDER BY "Bytes" DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Top ports / applications
panels.description: Applications and server ports (the lower port of a flow) of the CI's traffic.

targets.rawSql:
WITH
    ((${ref:sqlstring} != '' AND SrcCI = ${ref:sqlstring}) OR (${ip:sqlstring} != '' AND SrcAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring})) OR (${ref:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ip:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ci:sqlstring} != '' AND (SrcCI = ${ci:sqlstring} OR SrcHost = ${ci:sqlstring}))) AS from_ci,
    ((${ref:sqlstring} != '' AND DstCI = ${ref:sqlstring}) OR (${ip:sqlstring} != '' AND DstAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring})) OR (${ref:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ip:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ci:sqlstring} != '' AND (DstCI = ${ci:sqlstring} OR DstHost = ${ci:sqlstring}))) AS to_ci
SELECT
    if(App = '', '—', toString(App)) AS "Application",
    multiIf(Proto = 6, 'tcp', Proto = 17, 'udp', Proto = 1, 'icmp', Proto = 58, 'icmpv6', toString(Proto)) AS "Protocol",
    least(SrcPort, DstPort) AS "Server port",
    toFloat64(sumIf(Bytes, to_ci)) * 8 / $__range_s AS "In, bit/s",
    toFloat64(sumIf(Bytes, from_ci)) * 8 / $__range_s AS "Out, bit/s",
    sum(Bytes) AS "Bytes",
    count() AS "Flows"
FROM flow.flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (from_ci OR to_ci)
GROUP BY "Application", "Protocol", "Server port"
ORDER BY "Bytes" DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Top interfaces
panels.description: Exporter interfaces the CI's traffic passes (input and output side of each flow).

targets.rawSql:
WITH
    ((${ref:sqlstring} != '' AND SrcCI = ${ref:sqlstring}) OR (${ip:sqlstring} != '' AND SrcAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring})) OR (${ref:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ip:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ci:sqlstring} != '' AND (SrcCI = ${ci:sqlstring} OR SrcHost = ${ci:sqlstring}))) AS from_ci,
    ((${ref:sqlstring} != '' AND DstCI = ${ref:sqlstring}) OR (${ip:sqlstring} != '' AND DstAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring})) OR (${ref:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ip:sqlstring} = '' AND ${ci:sqlstring} != '' AND (DstCI = ${ci:sqlstring} OR DstHost = ${ci:sqlstring}))) AS to_ci
SELECT
    toString(ExporterName) AS "Exporter",
    toString(tupleElement(i, 1)) AS "Interface",
    toString(tupleElement(i, 2)) AS "Description",
    toString(tupleElement(i, 3)) AS "Boundary",
    toFloat64(sumIf(Bytes, tupleElement(i, 4) = 'in')) * 8 / $__range_s AS "In, bit/s",
    toFloat64(sumIf(Bytes, tupleElement(i, 4) = 'out')) * 8 / $__range_s AS "Out, bit/s",
    sum(Bytes) AS "Bytes"
FROM flow.flows
ARRAY JOIN [(InIfName, InIfDescription, InIfBoundary, 'in'), (OutIfName, OutIfDescription, OutIfBoundary, 'out')] AS i
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (from_ci OR to_ci) AND tupleElement(i, 1) != ''
GROUP BY "Exporter", "Interface", "Description", "Boundary"
ORDER BY "Bytes" DESC
LIMIT 20
